title: Structure-dependent effects of yeast- and Gleditsia-derived mannan oligosaccharides on dextran sodium sulfate-induced colitis in mice.
authors: Jin, Ziyi; Bian, Bin; Zhang, Wei; Wu, Qijun; Chen, Yanan; Lai, Chenhuan; Yong, Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究酵母和皂荚来源甘露寡糖对结肠炎小鼠的保护作用，虽含分子对接但对象为糖-受体互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Understanding how molecular architecture dictates the bioactivity of functional oligosaccharides remains a major challenge. Here, mannan oligosaccharides (MOS) were prepared from yeast cell wall mannan, and Gleditsia sinensis Lam. endosperm galactomannan, to investigate structure-function relationships in preventing inflammatory bowel disease. The protective effects of yeast-derived MOS (Y-MOS) and Gleditsia-derived MOS (G-MOS) were comparatively evaluated using a dextran sodium sulfate (DSS)-induced colitis mice model. Structural analysis revealed that Y-MOS primarily consisted of alpha-1,6 linked mannose with alpha-1,2/alpha-1,3 linked side chains, whereas G-MOS featured a beta-1,4 linked mannose backbone with alpha-1,6 linked galactose branches. Furthermore, both MOSs mitigated colitis symptoms, preserved colonic epithelial barrier integrity, and suppressed inflammatory cytokines, primarily through suppressing JAK2-STAT3 and NF-kappaB signaling pathways, regulating gut microbiota, and promoting short-chain fatty acid production. Notably, G-MOS was more effective than Y-MOS, particularly in immune regulation and modulation of gut microbiota. Molecular docking further revealed that the rigid beta-linked conformation of G-MOS exhibited stronger binding affinity toward inflammatory receptors, leading to more effective pathway inhibition, as validated in LPS-treated RAW264.7 cells. These findings elucidate a glycosidic topology-dependent molecular mechanism underlying MOS bioactivity, and identify beta-linked G-MOS as a promising, sustainable candidate for inflammation management.
abstract_zh: 理解分子架构如何决定功能性低聚糖的生物活性仍然是一个重大挑战。本研究从酵母细胞壁甘露聚糖和皂荚（Gleditsia sinensis Lam.）胚乳半乳甘露聚糖制备了甘露寡糖（MOS），以探究其在预防炎症性肠病中的构效关系。使用葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的结肠炎小鼠模型，比较评估了酵母来源MOS（Y-MOS）和皂荚来源MOS（G-MOS）的保护作用。结构分析显示，Y-MOS主要由alpha-1,6连接的甘露糖组成，并带有alpha-1,2/alpha-1,3连接的侧链，而G-MOS则以beta-1,4连接的甘露糖为主链，并带有alpha-1,6连接的半乳糖分支。此外，两种MOS均缓解了结肠炎症状，保持了结肠上皮屏障完整性，并抑制了炎症细胞因子，主要通过抑制JAK2-STAT3和NF-kappaB信号通路、调节肠道微生物群以及促进短链脂肪酸产生来实现。值得注意的是，G-MOS比Y-MOS更有效，尤其在免疫调节和肠道微生物群调控方面。分子对接进一步揭示，G-MOS的刚性beta-连接构象对炎症受体表现出更强的结合亲和力，导致更有效的通路抑制，这一点在LPS处理的RAW264.7细胞中得到了验证。这些发现阐明了糖苷拓扑结构依赖的分子机制，该机制支撑MOS的生物活性，并将beta-连接的G-MOS确定为炎症管理中有前景且可持续的候选物。
